semantic_argument: The root universally quantifies n,m:Nat with n,m<4694, covering every ordered pair among the selected 4694 laws. lawOf i=laws.get i, and the construction of laws maps zero-based index i to Law(i+1).

resolveImplication returns Implication ⊕ Refutation. In each branch, the root requires the corresponding checker=true together with (lawOf n).implies(lawOf m) or its negation, covering both checkable evidence and mathematical correctness.

PosFact.proof proves the corresponding implication; checkImplication checks that each step of the indexed chain connects. NegFact.h supplies a magma satisfying every law in satisfies and violating every law in refutes. checkRefutation connects that model to target n,m through two checked implication chains.
implies is defined as ∀G:Type [Magma G], satisfies G l₁ → satisfies G l₂, with no additional finiteness or algebraic-axiom restriction, matching the source's scope of general magmas.

The root uses concretely defined cert, pos and neg rather than assuming the caller supplies a complete certificate. cert_valid is an internal project theorem; the root has no unbound certificate-validity premise.

The independent source and frozen scope explicitly exclude the finite-magma graph from this target. The paragraph's engineering statistics describe project background; this label evaluates the selected all-ordered-pairs decision and correctness statement.
